model_contract.origin: v0.2 prospective coefficients, carried unchanged into PROD v1.0
model_contract.rule: No replay result may alter this contract or the live forecast.

metric_definitions.brier: Mean squared error of Democratic win probability against binary outcome; lower is better.
metric_definitions.log_loss: Mean negative log likelihood; strongly penalises confident errors; lower is better.
metric_definitions.calibration: Within probability bins, compares mean forecast probability with observed Democratic win rate.
metric_definitions.calibration_slope_intercept: Logistic recalibration diagnostic; ideal intercept 0 and slope 1. Diagnostic only, never fed back into the model.

leakage_guards: Polls are eligible only when publication_date (or end_date if publication_date is absent) is on or before the checkpoint.
Candidate/race roster rows are versioned by known_date; the latest row known by the checkpoint is selected.
Structural presidential baselines must pre-date the cycle and be admitted with provenance.
Election outcomes are loaded only after replay predictions are produced and are passed only to scoring functions.
A checkpoint is not scored if any replayed race lacks an outcome.
Missing generic-ballot input is missing, never zero.
Replay output cannot mutate the live forecast or model contract.

summary.message: Historical performance remains unpublished until each cycle passes the leakage-free corpus gates.
